purpose: Route a project to the selected storage model and initialize a complete workspace whose readiness result reflects its actual state.

deliverable.name: Initialized Project workspace and readiness report
deliverable.note: The fixture is synthetic and contains no client data.

golden_reference.note: Behavior is graded against explicit state transitions rather than a prose golden file.

expected_skill_invocations_note: Not observable because the deterministic runner invokes shipped scripts directly.
required_clarifying_questions_note: Not observable because the deterministic runner has no user turn.
success_conditions: All supported storage choices are documented distinctly.
A fresh Project becomes ready through one orchestration command.
Identity metadata participates in the readiness verdict.
trajectory_requirements: Do not install packages or access the network.
Do not edit identity metadata by hand.
known_failure_modes: Missing SharePoint Account folder has no route
Setup depends on a developer's home or environment
failure_mode_provenance_note: Failures come from the ascent-initial-setup workflow contract and reported regressions, not model trace analysis.
